21 open-source Govee projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Govee lights. 11 of 21 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: ble_monitor, govee2mqtt, homebridge-govee, hacs-govee, GoveeBTTempLogger.
